# Allow all web crawlers to access most content
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Explicitly prioritize main site content
Allow: /$
Allow: /2425/calendar$
Allow: /resources$
Allow: /donate$
Allow: /2425/programs$
Allow: /2425/members$
Allow: /projects$
Allow: /projects/we-hear-your-outcry$
Allow: /projects/uttam-shakti$
Allow: /donate/organizations$

# Explicitly block all tag pages on blog.lckhp.org (they're causing 5xx errors)
Disallow: /tag/
Disallow: */tag/*
Disallow: https://blog.lckhp.org/tag/
Disallow: https://blog.lckhp.org/tag/*

# Disallow RSS feeds (they should not be indexed directly)
Disallow: /*.xml$
Disallow: */rss.xml
Disallow: */feed.xml
Disallow: */rss

# Allow sitemaps explicitly
Allow: /sitemap.xml
Allow: /blog-sitemap.xml
Allow: /members-sitemap.xml

# Specify sitemap locations
Sitemap: https://lckhp.org/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://blog.lckhp.org/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://lckhp.org/blog-sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://lckhp.org/members-sitemap.xml
